summary: Mobix Labs, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of a $2.8M senior secured convertible promissory note to Leviston Resources, with net proceeds of ~$2.3M. The note carries 10% interest, matures October 18, 2026, and is convertible into Class A Common Stock subject to stockholder approval. The conversion price is the lower of the June 22, 2026 closing price or 85% of the lowest eight-day VWAP prior to conversion. The note was issued under an existing investor rights agreement, with an amended registration rights agreement. No special situation; this is a routine financing arrangement.
